verdict.rationale: The only evidence is the documented `npm create cloudflare@latest my-app` scaffolding command, plus framework support for full-stack apps (React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro). That implies a first-party starter-project flow, but the pack never describes a template catalog, use-case starters, or one-click deploy. missing for 10: documented template/starter catalog for common use cases, one-click deploy (e.g. deploy button or dashboard template deploy), description of what the create command scaffolds, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases

citations.quote: Build full-stack apps with your framework of choice, including React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro, React Router, and more
